fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1D15E90 (character_creation System load) allocates 0x40 bytes, zeroes a HashMap and registers destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870, which frees the values buffer at +0x30 without element destructors and then the key set (FUN_140582ad0) - a HashMap with trivially destructible values. ecl::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem::ProcessScreenFadeToRequests (EoCClient.dll+0x7EB620) walks every fade-to request component of its WorldView (which lists character_creation::ScreenFadeToRequestComponent) as 0x40-byte components with int16 keys at +0x20 (stride 2, user/player id) and 0x20-byte values at +0x30 - the same shape SE declares for camera::ScreenFadeToRequestManualOneFrameComponent. macOS default ctor: 64 zero bytes. Live (idle): all zero.

open_questions: The fade-to loops in ProcessScreenFadeToRequests were not individually matched to this component's type index; the identification rests on the destructor (trivial values) plus the shared value stride 0x20.
ScreenFadeCreationData itself still has field_10..field_1C unknowns in Camera.h.
